title: Severe but Harmless: Stress-Testing Shift Severity for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
abstract: arXiv:2611.21562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zero-shot time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have become attractive alternatives to task-specific models because they handle diverse downstream tasks, including anomaly detection and forecasting, without per-series training. However, time-series data undergo distribution shifts, and the dissimilarity between two regimes is commonly scored with statistical measures such as Wasserstein-1, where a higher score is read as a more severe shift. In systematic experiments using three established severity measures on nine regime shifts from three standard traffic datasets, we show that these measures do not reliably predict degradation for instance-normalized TSFMs. The regimes rated most severe are not the regimes that degrade the models most, and degradation reaches 29% in the lowest-scoring regime. translated_title: 严重但无害：对冻结时间序列预测器的偏移严重性进行压力测试
translated_abstract: 零样本时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）因其无需针对每个序列单独训练即可处理包括异常检测和预测在内的多种下游任务，已成为任务特定模型的有吸引力替代方案。然而，时间序列数据会经历分布偏移，两种状态（regime）之间的不相似性通常用诸如 Wasserstein-1 之类的统计度量来评分，分数越高被解读为偏移越严重。通过对来自三个标准交通数据集的九种状态偏移、使用三种已有的严重性度量方法进行系统性实验，我们证明这些度量无法可靠地预测实例归一化 TSFMs 的性能退化。被评为最严重的状态并非使模型退化最严重的状态，且退化在得分最低的状态中反而达到 29%。在大多数情况下，该审计显示所测量的严重性与模型退化之间不存在正相关关系。我们提供了一种基于等变性的压力测试（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过系统性实验证明，常用的分布偏移严重性度量（如 Wasserstein-1）无法可靠预测冻结的实例归一化时间序列基础模型在状态偏移下的性能退化——严重性评分最高的偏移未必造成最大退化，且退化在评分最低的偏移中反而可达 29%。
en_tdlr: Systematic stress tests reveal that standard shift-severity measures (e.g., Wasserstein-1) fail to reliably predict performance degradation of frozen, instance-normalized time-series foundation models under regime shifts—the most "severe" shifts are not the most harmful, with degradation reaching 29% even in the lowest-scoring shift.
